items.mainDefect: ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled throws UnsupportedOperationException, but the AdminPermissions client-removed listener calls it. When both the V1 and V2 fine-grained authz features are enabled, client deletion aborts.

secondary.defect: In V2-only mode the listener guard skips cleanup, so per-client authorization resources and permissions for deleted clients are left orphaned.

items.mainDefect: Per-client resources created by AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource never get the Clients type set, so getClientsWithPermission's findByType query misses per-client grants and returns an empty set.

secondary.defect: getClientsWithPermission adds the literal name of the schema-level "Clients" type resource to the result instead of a client ID, which causes an NPE in AvailableRoleMappingResource.
The V2 listener no longer cleans up resources when a client is removed, so orphaned entries for deleted clients can be returned and dereferenced.

items.mainDefect: testManageOnlyOneClient only asserts the default-client-scopes list is non-empty, then reads index 1, so it can fail with IndexOutOfBoundsException.

secondary.defect: testConfigureOnlyOneClient reads defaultClientScopes.get(0) without checking that the list is non-empty, so an empty list surfaces as a confusing IndexOutOfBounds failure.

items.mainDefect: ClientPermissionsV2.setPermissionsEnabled throws UnsupportedOperationException, but the AdminPermissions listener calls it on every ClientRemovedEvent, so each client deletion fails or raises the exception.

secondary.defect: Because of the exception, the per-client Clients authorization resource is never cleaned up, leaving orphaned resources for every deleted client.
